methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Blitzpanel is a pre-seed stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Ho. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 9 peers across robotics and manufacturing: 1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. The robotics and manufacturing sector contains 11 same-sector peers, but filtering for matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier yields fewer than three datapoints in any single category. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial methodological error given the stage-dependent dispersion in early-stage valuations and the heterogeneity of robotics subsectors. Consequently, traditional comparable company analysis cannot reliably constrain Blitzpanel's valuation at this time.

Without sufficient comparable data meeting triangulation thresholds, a quantitative valuation range cannot be responsibly derived from the available information. The analysis indicates a structural constraint: pre-seed robotics companies lack sufficient publicly-disclosed comparable transactions to support peer-based methods. Future valuation work would benefit from either (1) direct market intelligence on recent pre-seed rounds in robotics, (2) stage-adjusted multiples from seed or Series A transactions in the sector, or (3) cost-of-capital approaches anchored to founder track record and technology risk. Current data is insufficient to triangulate a defensible valuation.
